simpletools.title: Simple Tools
simpletools.option.enableFullDurabilityB:
Grants a bonus to mining speed and damage
when tools/weapons are near full durability.
Default: true.
simpletools.option.fullDurabilityThresho:
The fraction of durability required to
trigger the bonus (e.g., 0.9 for 90%).
Default: 0.8. Allowed range: 0.8–1.0.
simpletools.option.fullDurabilityBonusMu:
The multiplier applied to speed/damage (e.g.,
1.15 for +15%). Default: 1.0. Allowed range:
1.0–1.5. Applies to Vanilla and mod tools.
1.0 means no bonus; saved values are
retained.
Repairing or renaming at the anvil without
new enchantments does not raise the item's
anvil cost. Only enchanting does. Default:
true.
simpletools.option.enableFurnaceLavaFill:
Insert one lava bucket into an empty fuel
slot or exchange one leftover bucket. An
empty bucket remains in the furnace after
burning. Default: true.
simpletools.option.biomeBrushEnabled.too:
The Biome Brush paints the biome around a
clicked block. Off: every stroke is refused.
Default: true.
simpletools.option.biomeBrushOpsOnly.too:
Only operators may paint biomes. Default:
false.
simpletools.option.biomeBrushRadius.tool:
Biome cells (4 blocks each) painted around
the clicked cell. Default: 1. Allowed range:
0–2.
simpletools.option.enableSoulbound.toolt:
Items with Soulbound stay in their slot on
death and never drop. Off: they drop like
any item. Default: true.
simpletools.option.deathDurabilityCap.to:
Soulbound items and Death Vault returns
keep at most this much durability.
Default: 50. Allowed range: 1–2031.
simpletools.option.soulboundAnvilCost.to:
Levels for every anvil combination that
applies Soulbound. Default: 35. Allowed
range: 1–39.
simpletools.option.soulboundTraderChance:
Chance that a wandering trader sells one
Soulbound book for 24–32 diamonds.
Default: 0.05. Allowed range: 0–1.
simpletools.option.soulboundEndCityChanc:
Chance of a Soulbound book in an End City
treasure chest (after a data reload).
Default: 0.02. Allowed range: 0–1.
simpletools.option.deathVaultCostPerItem:
Future buy-back: diamonds (or Simple Money
bills) per returned item. Default: 4.
Allowed range: 1–64.
simpletools.option.deathVaultMaxPerOffer:
Future buy-back: items one offering returns
at most. Default: 3. Allowed range: 1–27.
simpletools.option.deathVaultMaxDeaths.t:
Future buy-back: deaths kept per player
(otherwise only the last). Default: 20.
Allowed range: 1–100.
simpletools.option.deathVaultRedeem.tool:
Future feature: buy lost death drops back
with an offering. Default: false (off).
screen.simpletools.death_vault.paused.ti: Chunk not loaded – timer paused (%s left)
screen.simpletools.death_vault.empty: Nothing dropped at the last death
simpletools.option.enableItemFrameInvisi:
Sneak + shears on a frame with an item
hides or shows the frame (costs 1
durability). An emptied hidden frame
shows again. Default: true.
simpletools.option.enableItemFrameLock.t:
Sneak + honeycomb or glass pane locks a
frame with an item: no turning, no taking out, no
breaking. Sneak + axe unlocks it.
Default: true.
simpletools.option.enableItemFrameRevers:
Sneak + right-click turns the item in a
frame backwards. Default: true.
tip.simpletools.frame_shears: Sneak + use on a framed item: hide or show the frame
tip.simpletools.frame_honeycomb: Sneak + use on a framed item: lock it; an axe unlocks
item.simpletools.biome_brush.tooltip: Biome material in off hand; sneak: one spot
simpletools.guide.page.1.title: Simple Tools
simpletools.guide.page.1: Furnaces filled with lava, durability bonuses, cheaper anvil repairs, the Soulbound enchantment and the Death Vault.
simpletools.guide.page.2.title: Furnace lava fill
simpletools.guide.page.2: Either hand inserts one lava bucket into a furnace, blast furnace, or smoker with an empty fuel slot or one leftover empty bucket. Locked furnaces and sneaking are excluded. Survival consumes the lava bucket;
simpletools.guide.page.3.title: Furnace lava fill
simpletools.guide.page.3: an existing empty bucket is returned exactly once. SimpleBuilding furnace subclasses are supported through the Vanilla interface.
simpletools.guide.page.4.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.4: Item frames and glow item frames, only while sneaking and only with an item in the frame:
simpletools.guide.page.5.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.5: shears hide or show the frame (Vanilla Invisible flag, 1 durability, Unbreaking counts). If the item is knocked out of a hidden frame, the frame shows again.
simpletools.guide.page.6.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.6: Honeycomb or a glass pane locks the frame (Vanilla Fixed flag, one honeycomb or pane): the item cannot be turned, taken out or swapped and the frame cannot be broken in survival or fall off.
simpletools.guide.page.7.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.7: Sneak + axe unlocks it (1 durability), like waxed copper; anyone with build rights may do it, claims and adventure mode are respected. Any other sneaking right-click turns the item backwards.
simpletools.guide.page.8.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.8: Without sneaking everything stays Vanilla, so a Simple Maps wayfinder in a frame still opens on a plain right-click. Server side only, sounds and wax particles are Vanilla's.
simpletools.guide.page.9.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.9: With SimpleBuilding installed there is still only this one behavior:
simpletools.guide.page.10.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.10: its older frame actions (own glass-pane lock state, sneaking shows a hidden frame) step aside when Simple Tools is loaded, and frames locked by the old state (SimpleBuildingLocked) become Fixed when they load.
simpletools.guide.page.11.title: Better item frames
simpletools.guide.page.11: The old pane drop on unlocking and the sneak-shows rule are gone (shears toggle visibility).
simpletools.guide.page.12.title: Durability bonus
simpletools.guide.page.12: Damageable held Vanilla and mod tools above the durability threshold can gain attack damage and mining speed. The default multiplier is 1.0 (no bonus), with a server-enforced range of 1–1.5. The threshold defaults to 80% (range 80–100%).
simpletools.guide.page.13.title: Durability bonus
simpletools.guide.page.14.title: Biome Brush
simpletools.guide.page.14: Brush in the main hand, a biome material in the off hand, right-click a block: the biome around it becomes the material's biome. One material and one durability point per stroke.
simpletools.guide.page.15.title: Thrift
simpletools.guide.page.15: Enchantment for every item with durability, levels I-III: +1/3 maximum durability per level, level III doubles it. Not combinable with Mending; Unbreaking still works.
simpletools.guide.page.16.title: Thrift
simpletools.guide.page.16: Anvil repair with material restores a quarter of the (larger) maximum per item, so the same number of items as without the enchantment repairs it fully.
simpletools.guide.page.17.title: Thrift
simpletools.guide.page.17: Enchanting table, trades and loot like other non-treasure enchantments.
simpletools.guide.page.18.title: Thrift
simpletools.guide.page.18: The id stays simplequalityoflife:thrift, so enchanted items from older worlds keep it; it also works with the sub-mod switched off.
simpletools.guide.page.19.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simpletools.guide.page.19: Repairing with material, combining two items without new enchantments or renaming keeps the higher anvil cost of the inputs instead of raising it. Only a change of enchantments raises it like vanilla.
simpletools.guide.page.20.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simpletools.guide.page.21.title: Commands
simpletools.guide.page.21: Permission level 2: /simpletools fullDurabilityBonus, anvilRepairKeepsCost, furnaceLava, itemFrameInvisible, itemFrameLock and itemFrameReverseRotate <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpletools.json.
simpletools.guide.page.22.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpletools.guide.page.22: Playable alone (config/simpletools.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Tools".
simpletools.guide.page.23.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpletools.guide.page.23: On the first start the old Simple QoL settings of this sub-mod are taken over once.
simpletools.guide.page.24.title: Soulbound
simpletools.guide.page.24: Treasure enchantment, one level, for everything that can carry the Curse of Vanishing (the two exclude each other).
simpletools.guide.page.25.title: Soulbound
simpletools.guide.page.25: An item with Soulbound never drops on death - also in PvP, but not in Hardcore, where it has no effect (like a bed or respawn anchor;
simpletools.guide.page.26.title: Soulbound
simpletools.guide.page.26: items can still be enchanted and say so in the tooltip) - and is back in the same slot after the respawn, with at most 50 durability left (min(current, 50)). Book only: never from the enchanting table, librarians or random loot;
simpletools.guide.page.27.title: Soulbound
simpletools.guide.page.27: a wandering trader sells one book for 24-32 diamonds now and then (5 % per trader), and End City treasure chests hold one very rarely (2 %).
simpletools.guide.page.28.title: Soulbound
simpletools.guide.page.28: Rarer than Mending. Applying it at the anvil always costs the full 35 levels; the grindstone removes it.
simpletools.guide.page.29.title: Death Vault
simpletools.guide.page.29: Crafted block (obsidian, eye of ender, soul sand or soul soil, chest). It shows what became of each item dropped at your last death, color coded with a legend:
simpletools.guide.page.30.title: Death Vault
simpletools.guide.page.30: still lying (green), picked up by you (blue) or by another player (red, the name shows on hover), burned in lava, fire or by a cactus (orange), despawned (gray), fallen into the void (purple), gone another way (yellow).
simpletools.guide.page.31.title: Death Vault
simpletools.guide.page.31: A lying item has a bar like a durability bar: how much of its five minutes is left. If its chunk is not loaded the timer stands and the field shows a pause mark. Buying lost items back with an offering is a future feature:
simpletools.guide.page.32.title: Death Vault
simpletools.guide.page.32: the code stays, option deathVaultRedeem is off by default.
simpletools.guide.page.33.title: (with Simple Money) Money bills as offering
simpletools.guide.page.33: When Simple Money is installed, its money bills count like diamonds in the Death Vault offering slot (optional tag entry, nothing changes without the mod).
simpletools.guide.page.34.title: Settings
simpletools.guide.page.34: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
